description: Lists the sealed bounties of BOTH levels (open: SealedBounty; verified: SealedBountyVerified, where only enclaves on a chip declared by a Proof of Cloud auditor count) and the products each level settles: level, contract, protocol, product, balance, deadline, pause, open or not. Read from the ArcHive API index; if the list is briefly unavailable, the tool says so (never a partial list).
name: arc_bounties
